subject.why: The steam locomotive is instantly identifiable with all requested vintage components.

category.why: The train rests firmly on grounded desert tracks with an appropriate sunny backdrop.

clean.why: The illustration is completely free of text, interface elements, and characters.

framing.why: The train is oversized, crowding the side boundaries and clipping the rear tender at the left edge.

colour.why: Palette is vibrant, warm, and separates well from the desert sky.

detail.why: Shapes remain readable and chunky without excessive micro-textures or busy clutter.

style.why: Render quality features the required smooth volumes and satin finish matching the references.

fix: Scale down the train slightly and center it to restore comfortable margins on the left and right sides.
